reason: I take dozens of orders a day and one wrong order hurts me more than 500 rupees saves. Nobody has shown me it puts money back in my till, and my udhaar diary already works for me.
objection: What if it writes the wrong order, or mishears a Hindi voice note, and I lose a customer's trust? Then I am checking every card anyway and it saves me nothing.
would_change_my_mind: A shop like mine, which I can phone, that has used it for a few months and can show me it cut wrong orders or got back udhaar I would have lost, plus a promise that I pay nothing if it makes mistakes.
